_about.status: DRAFT. Written by reading each topic's c-TF-IDF terms and its highest-probability documents. Not yet checked by a human; scripts/task2_label_topics.py attaches a verbatim quote to each so verification is a string match rather than a reread.
_about.note: Keyed by topic id. Re-running the model with different parameters renumbers the topics, so check the run manifest before trusting these.
